title: Pankaj Kedia (AI investor, 160 directs / 22 exits / 20 unicorns) on the SDSU fireside
summary: Pankaj Kedia — Global AI investor (160 direct investments, 25 funds, 22 exits, 20 unicorns; ex-BCG/Qualcomm/Intel) — recaps the Eric × Vidya Dinamani SDSU fireside, noting Eric's positive examples (Costco, Patagonia, Novo Nordisk, Cloudflare) and the cautionary one (Whole Foods).
blockquote: Eric, of Lean Startup and now Incorruptible fame, shared a number of fascinating stories around why companies fail due to lack of governance structures and short-term profit focus while citing a few positive examples ( Costco Wholesale, Patagonia, Novo Nordisk, Cloudflare ) and some not so good ones ( Whole Foods Market ).
attribution_title: Global AI Investor (160 directs, 25 funds, 22 exits, 20 unicorns); ex-BCG, Qualcomm, Intel
